from.description: The venues to merge into this one; they're deleted.

name.description: The name to keep: one of the venues' names or other names. The rest become other names.

addressFrom.description: When they have different addresses or parking spots, the venue (this one or one of from) whose address and parking to keep; otherwise the ones there are.

id.description: A pitch of one of the venues in from.

into.description: The pitch it's the same as: one of this venue's, or one kept from another. Its matches move to that pitch, its corners walked are added to it, and its name becomes another name of it.

name.description: Without into, the pitch is kept, under this name (its own, or a new one): no other pitch of the merged venue may have it.

pitches.description: What happens to each pitch of the venues in from: every one, once.

description: Venues to merge into one (DUP-7): the venue's details, and what happens to each of the others' pitches.
